Headers the plugin compiles against. plugin.h is a verbatim copy of the
Linux host contract. scintilla_min.h is the slice of the Scintilla C API
this plugin sends. Neither file is generated at build time, so the plugin
configures without a checkout of the editor.

plugin.h
  repository: https://github.com/nextpad-plus-plus/nextpad-plus-plus-linux
  commit: 8dec39c9f0f53aefc662520717fb7c0b6107fcdb
  path: src/plugin.h

scintilla_min.h
  same commit, values taken from src/sci_messages.h and scintilla/include/Sci_Position.h
  (Sci_Position is ptrdiff_t). The notification struct field order matches
  that header so beNotified can read the host's SCNotification.

Refresh both with tools/fetch-npp-headers.sh. Pass the editor checkout if
you already have one:

  tools/fetch-npp-headers.sh /path/to/nextpad-plus-plus-linux

With no argument the script downloads plugin.h and src/sci_messages.h from
the commit named above.
